title: HandsOnLLM/Hands-On-Large-Language-Models: practical notebooks for learning LLMs
friendlyTitle: Hands-On LLMs teaches language models with working notebooks
summary: This Apache-licensed repository contains the official code and notebooks for the O’Reilly book Hands-On Large Language Models. It ranked among today’s top AI-related GitHub movers and currently shows about 28,000 stars.
friendlySummary: This popular GitHub project contains the code for the O’Reilly book Hands-On Large Language Models. It gives learners practical notebooks to run and change.
whyItMatters: Learners can work through chapter-aligned examples covering language-model concepts and practical implementations, with notebooks that can be run and modified. It is a useful companion for people who learn better by testing code than by reading theory alone.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to learn how language models work by trying real examples. The notebooks are especially helpful if you prefer learning through code.
